text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since I became Nishino Flower's Trainer.
Training was going smoothly, and we were spending fulfilling days together, until one day...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, if you'd like... please have some of this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, my mom taught me the recipe yesterday!
So, I wanted you to try it too, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right. Trainer teaches me so carefully,
so training has been so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every day, there are more and more things I can do...
It makes me want to try harder and harder.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
"You've built such a wonderful relationship with your Trainer.
We really have so much to be thankful for."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yup. So, I really want to thank my Trainer...!
But what should I do? What can I even do...?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"If you make a big deal out of it, they might feel awkward. ...Oh!
Then how about this?! Don't say it's a thank-you gift—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I made you a boxed lunch before, you looked so happy... so, um...
I-If it isn't a bother, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Colorful vegetables and simmered dishes. Fried chicken that stays delicious even when cold—
every dish had a gentle flavor, making it a truly comforting meal.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: How... is it? Does it suit your taste...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave her my honest impression, saying the gentle flavors made me
want to eat it every single day. At that—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every day...! U-Understood!
Ehehe... I'm so glad you like it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She beamed with a radiant smile. She was probably delighted that her mother's recipe was praised.
Savoring the meal, I made sure to thank her once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Today's lunch includes my dad's favorite dish.
I hope it suits your taste too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I promised to meet up with some friends today, so I have to go now.
Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower bowed and hurried off.
I appreciated the lunch, but wasn't it a lot of work to make every day—
choice_data_list: Could this be because of yesterday...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Did she take my "I could eat this every single day" comment literally?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Resolving to at least offer to cover the grocery costs,
I was eating the lunch in the trainer's office when—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Good work! Hanging in there as always? Thought we could grab a bite and catch up.
If you're free, meet me by the main gate!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a message from a senior trainer who had helped me out in the past.
I was already getting full from the bento, but... I couldn't turn them down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing off every last bite of the lunch, I sprinted to the main gate.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder how today's lunch was. I hope Trainer
liked Dad's favorite dish too.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(What should I make tomorrow? If I ask Mom,
I'm sure she'll give me another new bento recipe—)

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text: You okay? I didn't think you had such a small appetite.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the meal, they taught me a lot about training routines and connecting with horsegirls.
I wanted to express my gratitude, but... my stomach felt like lead.
choice_data_list: Thank you both for today, I'm... *urgh*...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't force yourself to talk. Are you feeling sick?
Sorry, man, I shouldn't have invited you on such short notice!
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should apologize...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be...?
